Seven colours in the sky after rain.
White or grey, it floats in the sky.
Cold and white — perfect for snowmen.

activities.title: Listen to the seasons game. Write a word or number in each gap.

data.script: Valentina: Seasons quiz, Erik! My favourite season has orange leaves. … Erik: Autumn! Mine has snow and hot chocolate. … Valentina: Winter! Question two: when do the flowers open? … Erik: In spring. Our garden becomes a rainbow of colours! … Valentina: And the best season for the lake? … Erik: Summer, when the water is warm. We swim every afternoon. … Valentina: Last one: what do you see after rain and sun together? … Erik: A rainbow! Last week we saw one with both ends in the lake! … Valentina: Full marks! Winner of the seasons quiz!
